title: The Grandissimes
summary: "The Grandissimes" by George Washington Cable is a novel published in 1880. When Philadelphia abolitionist Joseph Frowenfeld arrives in the city, his friendship with the white Honoré Grandissime challenges the foundations of their slaveholding world.
